dedupeText: gritty cinematic car interior layout 90s aesthetic cinematic car interior overexposed vignette indie film saturated colors foreground boot creates a diagonal lead in line from the bottom left the white vignette isolates the car interior as a central island of color text blocks are anchored to the top left and bottom right corners to balance the composition combine a high key white vignette with a low key saturated interior photograph then anchor the composition with high contrast serif typography in the corners

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, overexposed photograph of four people inside a vintage car, framed by a soft white vignette that bleeds into the edges. The image features deep blues and purples in the shadows with blown-out highlights, creating a gritty, raw cinematic feel.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground boot creates a diagonal lead-in line from the bottom left.
The white vignette isolates the car interior as a central island of color.
Text blocks are anchored to the top-left and bottom-right corners to balance the composition.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The car interior occupies the central 70% of the frame, tilted slightly to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, reddish-brown lace-up boot in the immediate foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the foreground boot, moves right to the passengers, then up to the title text in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the central image, especially at the top and bottom edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and cyan (car interior and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in mid-tones with extreme value contrast between crushed blacks and blown highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to high-contrast primary and secondary hues

letterConstructionRules: Title uses a high-contrast serif with sharp terminals
Subtitle uses a condensed, clean sans-serif
Tight letter spacing in the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with a functional condensed sans-serif for secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, classic serif feel of the title.
Matches the clean, industrial feel of the bottom metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of four people in a vintage car interior. Use a 90s indie film aesthetic with heavy blue/cyan shadows and overexposed highlights. Place a large reddish-brown boot in the bottom-left foreground. Apply a heavy, soft-edged white vignette that fades the edges of the car into a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top-left using a bold, dark purple serif font with tight leading. Add a single line of metadata in the bottom-right using a condensed blue sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the vignette soft and fading to pure white?
Is the title text staggered and tight?
Does the foreground boot create a strong diagonal?

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white at the canvas edges.
Ensure text is legible against the white background.
Verify the 'blown-out' highlight effect on skin tones.
Confirm the color palette is limited to blue, purple, and white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key white vignette with a low-key, saturated interior photograph, then anchor the composition with high-contrast serif typography in the corners.
